answer: Re-attestations are stored in pearl and comet lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the reef graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 463 impostors cost 1851 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
